title: Decide what enough means before the day runs out
method: A conceptual sequence for the reflection exercise in this essay. The steps describe a possible practice, not a measured causal effect or a universal rule.
alt: Concept diagram: See the actual day — Include fixed obligations and available capacity.; Choose meaningful outcomes — Define what progress should enable today.; Update the commitments — Tell others when their expected result changes.; Leave a restart point — Close completed work and make the next step clear..
